user_intent: Show customers who have a birthday this week
sql_template: SELECT customer_id, first_name, last_name, birth_date FROM cai_customers WHERE weekofyear(birth_date) = weekofyear(current_date());

user_intent: Show deposits approaching maturity in the next 7 days
sql_template: SELECT deposit_id, customer_id, principal_amount, maturity_date FROM cai_deposits WHERE maturity_date BETWEEN current_date() AND days_add(current_date(), 7);

user_intent: Show active customers with their savings balance
sql_template: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, s.balance FROM cai_customers c INNER JOIN cai_savings s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE';

user_intent: Show top 5 customers with highest savings balance
sql_template: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, s.balance FROM cai_customers c INNER JOIN cai_savings s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id ORDER BY s.balance DESC LIMIT 5;
